_note: Small offline dataset of well-known papers for development and tests. Abstracts are short summaries written for this project, not the original abstracts. Citations reference other entries by key.

papers.title: A Relational Model of Data for Large Shared Data Banks
papers.abstract: Proposes describing data as mathematical relations so that applications are independent of how data is stored, introducing normal forms and a relational view of data banks.

venue.name: Communications of the ACM

papers.title: MapReduce: Simplified Data Processing on Large Clusters
papers.abstract: A programming model where users write map and reduce functions and the runtime parallelizes the job across thousands of machines, handling partitioning, scheduling and failures automatically.

venue.name: USENIX Symposium on Operating Systems Design and Implementation

papers.title: Spanner: Google's Globally-Distributed Database
papers.abstract: Describes a database that shards data across data centres worldwide while supporting externally consistent distributed transactions, made possible by a time API with bounded clock uncertainty.

venue.name: USENIX Symposium on Operating Systems Design and Implementation

papers.title: The Case for Learned Index Structures
papers.abstract: Argues that index structures such as B-trees can be viewed as models that predict the position of a key, and shows that learned models can replace them with lower memory use and faster lookups.

venue.name: ACM SIGMOD Conference

papers.title: The Anatomy of a Large-Scale Hypertextual Web Search Engine
papers.abstract: Presents a prototype web search engine that uses the link structure of the web to rank pages, computing a global importance score for each page from the pages that link to it.

venue.name: Computer Networks and ISDN Systems

papers.title: The Probabilistic Relevance Framework: BM25 and Beyond
papers.abstract: Reviews the probabilistic relevance framework behind the BM25 ranking function, explaining term frequency saturation, document length normalization and field weighting.

venue.name: Foundations and Trends in Information Retrieval

papers.title: Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space
papers.abstract: Introduces two simple architectures for learning word vectors from very large corpora, producing embeddings in which similar words lie close together and analogies appear as vector offsets.

venue.name: International Conference on Learning Representations

papers.title: GloVe: Global Vectors for Word Representation
papers.abstract: Learns word vectors by factorizing global word co-occurrence statistics, combining the strengths of count-based methods and local context window methods.

venue.name: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing

papers.title: Sequence to Sequence Learning with Neural Networks
papers.abstract: Uses one recurrent network to encode an input sequence into a fixed vector and a second to decode the output sequence, achieving strong machine translation results end to end.

venue.name: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems

papers.title: Neural Machine Translation by Jointly Learning to Align and Translate
papers.abstract: Lets the decoder search over the source sentence for the parts relevant to each output word, an attention mechanism that removes the fixed-length bottleneck of encoder-decoder models.

venue.name: International Conference on Learning Representations

papers.title: Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization
papers.abstract: An optimizer for stochastic gradient descent that adapts the learning rate of each parameter using estimates of the first and second moments of the gradients.

venue.name: International Conference on Learning Representations

papers.title: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
papers.abstract: Trains a large convolutional network on GPUs to classify a million images into a thousand classes, using rectified linear units and dropout to cut the error rate sharply.

venue.name: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems

papers.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
papers.abstract: Reformulates layers as learning residual functions with shortcut connections, which makes networks with more than a hundred layers trainable and more accurate.

venue.name: IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition

papers.title: U-Net: Convolutional Networks for Biomedical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract: A network with a contracting path for context and a symmetric expanding path for precise localization, trained end to end from few images with heavy data augmentation.

venue.name: Medical Image Computing and Computer-Assisted Intervention

papers.title: You Only Look Once: Unified, Real-Time Object Detection
papers.abstract: Frames object detection as a single regression from image pixels to bounding boxes and class probabilities, so one network pass detects objects in real time.

venue.name: IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition

papers.title: Generative Adversarial Nets
papers.abstract: Trains a generator and a discriminator against each other: the generator learns to produce samples the discriminator cannot tell apart from real data.

venue.name: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems

papers.title: Attention Is All You Need
papers.abstract: Proposes the Transformer, an architecture built only on attention mechanisms without recurrence or convolution, which trains faster and sets new translation benchmarks.

venue.name: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems

papers.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
papers.abstract: Pre-trains a deep bidirectional Transformer by predicting masked words and next sentences, then fine-tunes it with one extra layer to reach state of the art on many language tasks.

venue.name: North American Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics

papers.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
papers.abstract: Shows that scaling an autoregressive language model to 175 billion parameters lets it perform new tasks from a few examples in the prompt, without gradient updates.

venue.name: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems

papers.title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
papers.abstract: Applies a standard Transformer directly to sequences of image patches and shows that, pre-trained on enough data, it matches or beats convolutional networks.

venue.name: International Conference on Learning Representations

papers.title: Playing Atari with Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Learns control policies directly from raw pixels with a convolutional network trained by a variant of Q-learning, outperforming earlier approaches on several Atari games.

venue.name: NeurIPS Deep Learning Workshop

papers.title: Mastering the Game of Go with Deep Neural Networks and Tree Search
papers.abstract: Combines policy and value networks trained by supervised and reinforcement learning with Monte Carlo tree search to defeat a professional Go player.

venue.name: Nature

papers.title: Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithms
papers.abstract: A family of policy gradient methods that alternate between sampling data and optimizing a clipped surrogate objective, simpler to implement than trust-region methods.

venue.name: arXiv

papers.title: Translating Embeddings for Modeling Multi-relational Data
papers.abstract: Represents a knowledge graph relation as a translation between entity embeddings, so that head plus relation should land near tail, a simple model that scales to large graphs.

venue.name: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems

papers.title: node2vec: Scalable Feature Learning for Networks
papers.abstract: Learns node embeddings by running biased random walks that balance breadth-first and depth-first exploration, then training a skip-gram model on the walks.

venue.name: ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining

papers.title: Semi-Supervised Classification with Graph Convolutional Networks
papers.abstract: Defines a layer-wise propagation rule that approximates spectral graph convolutions, letting a neural network classify nodes using both features and graph structure.

venue.name: International Conference on Learning Representations

papers.title: Inductive Representation Learning on Large Graphs
papers.abstract: Learns functions that generate node embeddings by sampling and aggregating features from a node's neighbourhood, so embeddings can be produced for nodes never seen in training.

venue.name: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems

papers.title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
papers.abstract: Retrieves passages with dense vectors from a dual BERT encoder trained on question-passage pairs, outperforming BM25 for open-domain question answering.

venue.name: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing

papers.title: ColBERT: Efficient and Effective Passage Search via Contextualized Late Interaction over BERT
papers.abstract: Encodes queries and documents separately with BERT and scores them by a cheap late interaction between token embeddings, keeping BERT quality at a fraction of the cost.

venue.name: ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
papers.abstract: Combines a pre-trained generator with a dense retriever over Wikipedia, so the model conditions its answers on retrieved passages and produces more factual text.

venue.name: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
